column1: # case: name, entry path row, scratch capacity
# mode: optional bootstrap or native compilation mode
# file: canonical identity row, normalized virtual path, raw source (or - for an alias)
# expect: exact probe row. Function and type bindings include owner, name, defining file, node index, start, end.
# C bindings have the same columns and a c-target row with header, native name or type literal, and declaration signature spans.
# The c-owner row holds the defining type index and the destructor span for a resource type or result.
# Module rows include identity, reached path row, discovery order, active flag, traversal state.
# Error rows include code, file identity, byte start and end, line and column.
